messages:
diane: quick flag 1:30 UTC 1 marred with soft fncall schema fixes on route 'billing-main' - runtime coerced tool args and routed to fallback, customers saw latency blips.
rui: can you share a sample logged payload?
diane: logged sample (trimmed): 
```json
{"tool":"charge_v2","args":{"amount":12.5,"currency":"USD"},"meta":{"route":"billing-main-us"}}
```
emma: amount as float vs cents int again. runtime did float->int_cents coercion. we must surface this to support and console, not silently mutate.
kyle: proposal: emit flat telemetry event `fncall.schema_flag` with keys: level, type, orig_route, exec_variant, coercions (list), billed_route, charged_on_exec ("true"/"false"), sample_span. make it queryable in Console and hook into billing reconciliation.
diane: sampling rules: keep first 3 per route/hr, then 0.5% random. redact payload PII.
rui: agreed. storage: kafka topic `telemetry.fncall_flags.v1` -> materialized table for Console. metrics: increment `fncall.schema_flags.soft_fix` with tags (orig_route, exec_variant, region).
kyle: rollout: 1% canary 48h -> 5% 7d. stop if flags > 4% of fncalls or billing delta > 12%.
infra-bot: deploy queued: feature/fncall-flags -> staging, CI 6/7 passed.
diane: action items: (1) kyle draft event schema PR, (2) emma mock Console pill + sample panel, (3) rui wire kafka/topic + retention, (4) diane add runtime flag `fncall.schema_flags` behind kill-switch.
kyle: i'll open the PR now and include event examples and sampling.
emma: i'll post Console mock by EOD.
diane: thanks all, will follow up after 5% canary with metrics.
kyle: naming ack on `fncall.schema_flag` / `soft_fix`.
